criteria.description: Elaborate 4-pillar wedding Mandap with gold pillars, royal canopy arches, and draped fabric.
criteria.look_for: Distinct gold pillars, draped canopy with gradients, ornate archways, floral strings.

criteria.description: Bride & Groom in traditional royal Indian wedding attire with clear silhouettes and detailed ornaments.
criteria.look_for: Groom in sherwani with safa/turban, kalgi feather, pearl necklace; Bride in red & gold lehenga/dupatta, maang tikka, bangles, bridal jewelry; varmala garland.

criteria.description: Sacred Hawan/Agni Kund fire pit placed between the couple with radiant fire glow.
criteria.look_for: Stepped brick/copper fire altar with layered yellow, orange, and red flames emitting warmth and light.

criteria.description: Rich festive Indian wedding ambiance including rangoli, glowing diyas, marigold torans, and celestial night sky.
criteria.look_for: Intricate symmetrical rangoli on the floor, lighted clay diyas with glow, marigold strings, glowing moon and stars.

criteria.description: Celebratory wedding banner text 'SHUBH VIVAH' with elegant typography and ornamental symbols.
criteria.look_for: Gold serif text with Swastik/Kalash/Diya motifs or decorative brackets, well centered.
